summary: Open CC0 datasets from individual predation experiments exist (a 21-site global artificial-moth experiment, blue tit detection times, a survival experiment on camouflaged targets, lizard survival by colour genotype). They are separate studies of different systems, not one table, and image and specimen archives (GBIF, iNaturalist) lack colour scoring or survival data.
